title: Vik Ryan warns you

nodes.speaker: Vik Ryan
nodes.text: You again? Are you stalking me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You again? Are you stalking me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I just want to ask you a question.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just want to ask you a question.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I just want to ask you a question.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I just want to ask you a question.

nodes.speaker: Vik Ryan
nodes.text: I don't answer questions. I'm selling things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't answer questions. I'm selling things.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Great. I'm interested in a watch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great. I'm interested in a watch.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Great. I'm interested in a watch.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Great. I'm interested in a watch.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Okay, do you have a mechanical one?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay, do you have a mechanical one?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Okay, do you have a mechanical one?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Okay, do you have a mechanical one?

nodes.speaker: Vik Ryan
nodes.text: Someone named Franco Miliscent is building new mechanical watches. You should talk to him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Someone named Franco Miliscent is building new mechanical watches. You should talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Vik Ryan
nodes.text: Again. Franco Miliscent is your man. Or check out the Sewers flee market next Saturday.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Again. Franco Miliscent is your man. Or check out the Sewers flee market next Saturday.

nodes.speaker: Vik Ryan
nodes.text: If I had one, I would live in the Spire. You're looking for the stolen Long & Sons, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I had one, I would live in the Spire. You're looking for the stolen Long & Sons, right?

nodes.speaker: Vik Ryan
nodes.text: I must warn you, the bastards who took it are out of your league. The Curzonas wouldn't dare to touch them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I must warn you, the bastards who took it are out of your league. The Curzonas wouldn't dare to touch them.

nodes.speaker: Vik Ryan
nodes.text: So whoever lost that watch needs friends in the Spire. Cause that's where this watch is. In the highest circles.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So whoever lost that watch needs friends in the Spire. Cause that's where this watch is. In the highest circles.

nodes.speaker: Vik Ryan
nodes.text: There were five people here asking about that watch before you. And they all looked much stronger, tougher and smarter.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There were five people here asking about that watch before you. And they all looked much stronger, tougher and smarter.

nodes.speaker: Vik Ryan
nodes.text: I wouldn't go near such a thing. Too risky.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wouldn't go near such a thing. Too risky.

nodes.speaker: Vik Ryan
nodes.text: Go home and tell the person who sent you that they're in trouble now. And so are you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go home and tell the person who sent you that they're in trouble now. And so are you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, really not. I just have a question.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, really not. I just have a question.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, really not. I just have a question.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, really not. I just have a question.
